$comment: Task #4180 — owner-reviewed frozen allow-list for OBSERVED-PUBLIC routes (routes whose registration carries no recognized auth middleware, per tests/route-inventory.ts). 'observed_public' means the static parser saw no auth middleware in the registration — many entries below ARE protected by in-handler checks the parser cannot see (X-Cron-Key, HMAC signatures, capability tokens, spread `...guard` arrays, custom middleware references). Enforced by scripts/lint-route-classification.ts: any net-new observed-public route not listed here fails the gate. Adding an entry here is an L3 change requiring owner approval (Architecture Governor); removing entries (routes deleted or given real middleware) is always allowed and REQUIRED when they go stale. Classes: signed_webhook_in_handler | machine_token_in_handler | capability_token | oauth_callback | custom_middleware_unrecognized | intentional_public.
